author: blu
body: The command bridge: a live, parameterized cockpit for the Magic format solver. Menus set the exploration parameters -- Set, Format, Year, Generations -- and Run spawns the real engine in codex-vm over the chosen SimProfile (the year resolves to a rules epoch, the format filters the legal pool). Each run is saved. View switches the main panel between lenses: Sets & Epochs, Formats, Decks & Winner, AI Personalities, and History (past runs). The heavy simulation stays in the CDX VM; this app drives it, renders the result, and persists it. The plug supplies the builtins below (declared here as stubs, implemented in C#).
